correctness.rationale: PASS: Gaussian polar decomposition separates chi-square squared radii from independent uniform directions. Every normalized factor has second-moment identity; conditioning out removed radial variables makes additional normalization an exact conditional expectation, so convex order and unbiasedness follow for arbitrary nonzero real PSD H. A product-state maximizer has positive spherical-neighborhood measure. AM–GM bounds a probe by (c rho/r^r)(sum squared radii)^r and the sum over m samples by one chi-square sum, giving the upper logarithmic t^{1/r} rate. Requiring one sample’s r independent chi-square radii to exceed a balanced threshold near the maximizing directions gives the matching lower rate; r=0 bounded, r=1 positive exponential moment below its sharp strict threshold, r>=2 none. No critical equality MGF claim. Independent rational chi-square calculations corroborated E Z^2 64/32/16 for H=I4 and the Bell projector product-state radius 1/2. Tail proof is analytic.
